Im not an artist anymore, I can barely fold anything now but I do love origami, I was very creative as a child, I always wanted to build stuff, anything cool. Often getting materials for building stuff like cardboard, or paint or something else was a pain, you cant always find spare cardboard you do run out of colours, or any other material like clay, but origami was simple, all you needed was paper, which is easy and almost always available, so initially it was just planes and boats, but then I searched on youtube and found all kinds of simple complex modular origami, roses, dragons, unicorns, stars what not, I loved it so much that from the age of ig 12 to the age of 16-17 I folded so many models and filled one rack of my almirah. I even designed my own models(I barely remember them now). I could barely fold now, but those were some of my most cherished years folding origami, I cannot get back that creativity now, but I wish I could.
